ruleDefinitions.name: Access of Sudoers File Content
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a text-based file access or inspection utilities to read the content of /etc/sudoers in order to potentially list all users that have sudo rights.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ed$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/egrep$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/emacs$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/fgrep$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/grep$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/head$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/less$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/more$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nano$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tail$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/etc\\/sudoers.*"))
